ranks: Build ASAP: cards flagged in the library. `/author-flagged overnight` (2026-11-07), 95 flagged at the start, all but Heroic Sacrifice blocked; four agents at once in their own worktrees, by `--by-rank`. Keys built so far: `decision:choose-different-players` (Gluntch: `choose-opponent`'s `thenAnother`, `except` and `purpose`), `stat:countered-spell-mana-spent` (Mana Sculpt: mana spent read as the spell last was on the stack, rule 608.2h), `cost:plot-cost-reduction` (Doc Aurlock: a static's `plotCostReduction`), `effect:attach-equipment-that-was-attached` (Zack Fair, with Rhuk, Hexgold Nabber: `LastKnownInfo.attachments` and the filter's `wasAttachedTo`; Cass, Hand of Vengeance's Aura cards returned from the graveyard are not covered and need a narrower key), `effect:double-x-on-cast` (Unbound Flourishing: `double-x` and the `activates-ability` trigger's `xInCost`), `effect:add-mana-target-player` (The Warring Triad, Radiant Lotus: `add-mana`'s player `target`, not a mana ability, rule 605.5a), `static:double-triggers-of-attached` (Wizard's Staff: `doubleTriggersOf`'s `host`), `effect:play-from-library-top-this-turn` and `cost:pay-life-equal-mv-instead-of-mana` (Gwenom, with The Belligerent: `player-effect`'s library-top permissions until end of turn), `effect:opponent-chooses-exiled-this-way-excluded` (Plargg and Nassari: `cast-now`'s `exceptChosen`), `effect:linked-exile-from-discard` (Currency Converter, no engine code), `effect:additional-end-step` (Y'shtola Rhul, rule 500.9: `additional-end-step`, the `endStep` turn-structure clause, `DelayedTrigger.createdInEndStep`). Heroic Sacrifice needed no engine code. Round 3: `zone:cast-one-from-milled-until-end-of-turn` and `zone:impulse-play-only-one` (Locke, with Unlucky Witness: `GameState.permissionGroups`, plays shared across graveyard and exile permissions, `upTo`; Flameskull and March of Reckless Joy go to `--stale` and may need more), The Ur-Sphinx and Ark of Hunger with no engine code, `mechanic:more-than-meets-the-eye` (Slicer, rule 702.162a, with living metal and convert; a transforming card's back face can no longer be cast without a permission, 712.11), `effect:extra-combat-attack-restriction` (Bumi: `additional-combat`'s `onlyAttackers`; Last Night Together, Intimidation Bolt, Boros Battleshaper and Forgestoker Dragon need narrower keys), `effect:cast-this-way-owner-loses-life` (Kefka: `thisWay`'s `byOwner`).
